643-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2464-3249-5173.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5173.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5173.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2018-6288-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-728-5434-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-7399.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1170-1636-7443-7875.description:
Cast Regrowth using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Abundance.
When Emeritus of Abundance enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

372-2781-3306.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-3306.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

4390-5078-5901-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites:
You control two other untapped artifacts.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
4390-5078-5901-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

1129-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Allies.
1129-7500.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

3647-3821-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3647-3821-7487.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake
When Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3647-3821-7487.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2034-4365-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4365-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1563-3490-7075-7292.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-7075-7292.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2366-4452-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2034-2366-4452-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

654-3293-5226-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
654-3293-5226-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
654-3293-5226-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4067-4182-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
4067-4182-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

2034-3464-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1365-3263-4853-6797--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-6797--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1353-1718-1768-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-1718-1768-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2178-5173-5231-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-5231-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {R}.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

914-3967-5140.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3967-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
914-3967-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2178-2921-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-2921-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

997-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
997-5805--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, scrying 1.
Repeat.

751-1741-4249-5914.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least three.
751-1741-4249-5914.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx's last ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate any other land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it and Clement trigger
Resolve the Clement trigger, choosing to return Shrieking Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping the land(s) from step 1 and 2.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Clement trigger
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand
Resolve the Clement trigger, choosing to return nothing
Repeat
751-1741-4249-5914.notes:
If your devotion to blue is at least four, this also produces infinite mana and infinite untap of lands you control.

If you have a creature with mana value 0 that can survive after being cast for 0 mana, you can bounce it each time in step 9 and also cast it infinite times.

533-914-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
533-914-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasure tokens, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2-1651-2397-4563.notablePrerequisites:
Everflowing Chalice has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four.
2-1651-2397-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

253-2798-4551-4827.description:
Activate Evra by paying {4}.
Holding priority, cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Activate Soul of Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

2060-2589-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ridgescale Tusker.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

317-3192-5231.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
317-3192-5231.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

1694-3059-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
1694-3059-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

776-1329-2593-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2593-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Astral Cornucopia to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Cast Astral Cornucopia.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1584-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
1584-3932-4222.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Teferi's Isle and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
